children: CBOT December corn (CZ26) may retest a resistance at $5.39-3/4 per bushel, a break above which could lead to a gain into the $5.43 to $5.46-1/2 range.
Prices have been zigzagging higher within a rising channel. As long as the market remains above the support at $5.30-3/4, the uptrend would be considered intact.

Riding on a wave (5), the trend is expected to eventually extend to $5.49-3/4. A break below $5.30-3/4, however, will violate both the channel and the trend. A bearish target zone of $5.24-1/2 to $5.28 will be established accordingly.
On the daily chart, the uptrend from $4.57-1/4 is assumed to have continued. However, the trend looks weak, as symbolised by the small white and black candles over the past few trading sessions.
A break below the support at $5.28-1/4 is likely to be followed by a drop to $5.23-1/2. The drop would confirm the extension of the short downtrend from $5.49-3/4.
